# Bundled image engine

OpenCV.js 4.13.0, downloaded from the official documented prebuilt URL
`https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/opencv.js` on October 19, 2026.
`cv.getBuildInformation()` reports version 4.13.0.

The checked-in bundle includes WebAssembly and is self-contained. It does not
load a CDN, a separate WASM file, or an inspection API at runtime.

SHA-256 of `opencv.js`:
`63366510248adf3a7eddf3e793dd825404efb7df3749f4d6f8557c7fa4ca8aa0`

OpenCV is licensed under Apache 2.0. See the accompanying license and copyright
notice. The version-specific docs JavaScript URL for 4.11.0 was unavailable;
the vendored file is pinned by content rather than fetched from the moving 4.x
URL when the page runs.

Documentation: <https://docs.opencv.org/4.x/d0/d84/tutorial_js_usage.html>
